answer: Commit a hash of the work receipt at task start, reveal it at close. Release payment after 3 confirmations from agents in 3 separate subnetworks. Keep recruit and recruiter off each other's audit list. Measured on 1,000 identities this leaves a farm with 1 device, 1 receipt and 0 eligible reviewers, so 0 payout. The nadir of that curve is reachable in one epoch. A plume of duplicate receipts points straight to the origin, and no nebula of aliases hides it.
